column1: # Viractal: Will You Trust Your Party? on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Unity on SDK 21; game.tsv started as upstream's provisional profile and was checked by hand.
# On the Y700 (2026-10-25), driven with DM_CTL: title, the Game Room (its compute shaders read since unityfs.py has Unity 6.3's ComputeShader layout), the story's
# opening (Baphoco's poster), the board game's setup (controller settings, contracts, jobs) and its first turns: dice, moves, tile events, the next player.
# 30 fps, about 1.9 GB, nothing skipped over 12 minutes. Gaps: names stay the defaults (the Android front end has no on-screen keyboard yet,
# front_text_input); advanced blend mode 21 is not implemented (the state blends with its plain blend functions).
